specification.centered_regression_policy: Retain legacy computation only as explicitly non-independent diagnostic; centered intercept is the mean, not independent confound adjustment.
specification.eligibility: All four roles, exact stripped expected top token on both factual forms, and at least one other included fact in the same domain/split. No replacement questions.
specification.interpretation: Late expanded observational analysis, not a new confirmatory sample or independent replication. Original and expanded cohorts overlap; facts within a domain share other-fact comparators. Fact bootstrap intervals and sign-flip p-values therefore have limited independence justification. The exact within-domain label permutation is conditional on exchangeability of factual pairing, not a randomized causal test or a control for wording and answer-token confounds. Secondary comparisons are exploratory; repeated feature subsamples are not new independent facts.
specification.numerical_optimization: Memoize identical set-pair Jaccard calls; retain original exact enumeration/statistics.
planned_outputs: fact bootstrap and one-sided sign-flip summaries
specification.primary_contrast: same-fact rewording minus mean other-fact rewording overlap within domain and split
specification.raw_logit_extraction: Match the existing converter: sort raw logit nodes by token_prob; direct token or Output/Logit clerp extraction; take first decodable token among top ten.
specification.raw_representation: Family/layer/feature identity; collapse token positions; exclude ambiguous IDs, errors, embeddings and logits as implemented by whole_graph_analysis. Error-inclusive sensitivity retained separately.

size_sensitivity.interpretation: Algorithmic feature subsampling, not independent replication or additional sample size

specification.study_status: Late expanded observational analysis with separate original-cohort reconstruction
